name: zcode-dsh-stats
target: Official ZCode desktop; additive app.asar entry loader, no source build
ui: Single centered 24px statistics row immediately outside and below the composer card, with a 3px top gap; never grows the input card or wraps. While the row is present, reduce the desktop dock's original 16px bottom padding to 2px; restore native spacing when removed. Includes turns, completed requests, recent-window weighted decode tok/s, cumulative tokens, cache hit, native context percentage; narrow panes hide secondary counts/cache.
source: Read-only SQLite model_usage; completed main_turn requests in retained local records (normally 30 days); exact pane session ID and native context.
speed: sum(output_tokens) / sum(completed_at - first_token_at) over the most recent completed requests (window of 5; shorter sessions use what exists); completed requests, not streaming instantaneous rate; the numerator, decodeMs and speedSamples always cover the same window, and speedWindow caps the coverage target
unknown: Normalize legacy inclusive/exclusive cached input using official totals; missing persisted zero requires raw numeric evidence; partial samples are marked.
isolation: No project, credential, session or model configuration writes; no network; maintenance-only SessionStart hook ignores prompt input; each pane owns its session
installation: Snapshot app.asar before install; validate all packed file contents; atomic replacement; uninstall removes only our marked loader and preserves other changes
acceptance: outside-card placement, centered single row, at most 27px added height

automaticRestore.enablement: One-time explicit setup; no daemon or external network
guardrails: stable target and content hash checked
renderer selectors and Electron integrity mode validated
automaticRestore.activation: Restored entry becomes active on next normal app restart
automaticRestore.windowsDeferred: When the running Windows client locks app.asar, a single detached bounded worker waits up to 24 hours for that exact executable path to exit, then validates current target and installs. Opt-out cancels it; it never forces a restart or replays a stale prepared archive. Next session can requeue after timeout.

detailCards.activity: Client-recorded model request duration sum; associated main-turn tool dispatch-to-terminal intervals, including queues/approval waits and terminal errors/cancellations, with parallel overlap summed; mean TTFT from paired samples; recent-window (5) weighted decode TPS with window coverage. Each metric has sample coverage.
detailCards.tokens: Total plus cache hit, uncached input/cache read/cache write/output where supported. When cache write is unknown, label input minus cache read as non-cache-read input. Partial totals are marked individually, never falsely reconciled.
detailCards.context: Native used/limit and remaining capacity, with an accessible utilization bar. System/tool/message token breakdown is unavailable; never infer token fractions from character counts.
detailCards.interaction: Each pill opens its own anchored card; live data refresh, viewport clamping, one active card, keyboard/outside-click dismissal. Streaming timeline scroll and card-content scroll keep the card open; ancestor scroll and resize update its position, and an offscreen trigger closes it. No wall of static calculation notes.

platforms.macOS: Official ZCode.app; POSIX locks; Electron Framework fuse inspection; bundled MacOS/ZCode CLI. Existing support retained.
platforms.Windows: Official ZCode.exe/resources/app.asar; native msvcrt byte locks; EXE fuse inspection; bundled ZCode.exe CLI. UTF-8 JSON/process-hook output, explicit --asar and persistent Python paths. No elevation or forced process termination.
platforms.validation: Windows 11 x64 / official ZCode 3.14.4 and 3.16.3: PowerShell installation, native session data, and all three live cards verified. On 2026-10-25, a real official stable-channel upgrade from 3.14.4 to 3.16.3 replaced the loader; native SessionStart queued automatic recovery, normal exit allowed the worker to restore it, and all three cards passed after restart without manual setup or restore commands. macOS 3.16.3 compatibility retained. Future upgrades are not assumed compatible.
